meta.title: Press kit — Vendora
meta.description: Vendora's logo, colours, quick facts and press contact.

hero.title: Everything you need to <gold>write about us.</gold>
hero.body: Our logo and colours, the short version of what we do, and a real person you can email.

what.label: What it is
what.body: An event marketplace where hosts find, message and book vendors, and keep each event's date, guests and notes in one place. Weddings, birthdays, corporate events, parties and more.

reviewed.label: How vendors are reviewed
reviewed.body: Every listing is reviewed by the Vendora team before it goes live.

vendors_get.label: What vendors get
vendors_get.body: A listing with portfolio photos, packages and prices; one inbox for inquiries; proposals and contracts clients sign online; and secure online payments. The Free plan includes one listing.

finding.label: Finding vendors
finding.body: Search by category, city and date, with a page for each city and category.

brand.title: Logo and colours
brand.usage: Use the logo on Ink (#14161A) or Ivory (#F4F1EA). Don't stretch, recolour or rotate it, or add effects. Need a logo file? Email us.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.body: Editorial requests, interviews and partnership inquiries. We read every message.
